thread:
Meera Patel: hit a production bug yesterday where fastpath->slowpath handoff + upstream reset caused a client to replay a streaming POST and we duplicated webhook deliveries.
Omar Khan: ouch. Can you share the minimal trace?
Meera Patel: simplified:
```
CLIENT -> EDGE: POST /v1/webhook (chunked stream)
EDGE: fastpath accepts, then transfers to slowpath at t=4.2s
UPSTREAM: returns 200, then TCP reset during trailers
CLIENT: immediately retries identical request (no Idempotency-Key)
```
Sasha Ivanov: If the gateway doesn't know retry origin, downstream services can't decide whether to dedupe. We should add a small set of headers the gateway controls.
Rajiv Menon: propose: X-Edge-Retry-Origin: gateway|client|upstream, X-Edge-Retry-Id: uuid, X-Edge-Retry-TTL: seconds. Gateway sets these only when it itself retries/resumes.
Meera Patel: and policy for client-origin retries? We can't safely accept mid-stream client retries without idempotency. So reject with 409 and machine-friendly body if mid-stream and no Idempotency-Key.
Omar Khan: agree. Specific rules: 1) header-only retries (pre-commit) => coalesce if Idempotency-Key matches or same conn id. 2) mid-stream client replay without Idempotency-Key => 409 + JSON {"error":"retry_requires_idempotency","hint":"attach-Idempotency-Key","docs":"/edge/retries"} and header X-Edge-Retry-Allowed: false. 3) Gateway-origin resumes include X-Edge-Retry-Origin: gateway and X-Edge-Retry-Id with TTL.
Sasha Ivanov: implementational constraints: we can't buffer large bodies. Gateway resumes only supported when resumable tokens are used (stream offsets + small KV checkpoint). Otherwise gateway-origin retries must be failover only (return error upstream).
Rajiv Menon: ops note: GC state for retry ids after TTL and limit per-route resume-state memory. default TTL 30s, configurable per route. Emit metric: edge.retry.origin.{gateway,client,upstream} and edge.retry.rejected_midstream_no_idempotency.
Meera Patel: I'll draft the RFC follow-up with examples and a tiny test harness. Example curl error response to document (when mid-stream replay rejected):
```
HTTP/1.1 409 Conflict
Content-Type: application/json
X-Edge-Retry-Allowed: false

{"error":"retry_requires_idempotency","docs":"https://docs.redwood.ai/edge/retries"}
```
Omar Khan: SDK migration path: detect 409+retry_requires_idempotency -> surface to user and optionally auto-add Idempotency-Key on manual retry. Don't auto-retry mid-stream for streaming bodies unless SDK supports resumable tokens.
Sasha Ivanov: small header name bikeshed: X-Edge-Retry-* avoids collisions with existing Idempotency-Key headers. Good.
deploy-bot: queued: feature/edge-retry-headers (PR #4341)  CI passed :white_check_mark:
Meera Patel: thanks. I'll include unit tests for header propagation, an integration scenario that simulates fastpath->slowpath transfer, and a load test to validate resume-state GC under pressure. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform for review. :pray:
